verdict.rationale: Synthesia's own docs say you can write a prompt or script and get a finished video with AI avatars and voiceovers, and its Video API generates scripted avatar videos (docs-22, docs-15). Custom avatars can be made from a single photo or as personal/branded presenters 'without repeated filming', which satisfies the no-camera, no-studio requirement (docs-2, docs-24). One community report calls a Synthesia presenter 'uncanny', which is a realism concern rather than evidence that the workflow fails. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a ready-made stock avatar library, a step-by-step paste-script workflow in the editor, and independent hands-on corroboration of presenter quality.
